name: actor-24-clinical-trials-delta-engine
title: ClinicalTrials.gov + FDA Orange Book - Trial Delta API
description: Delta-tracks ClinicalTrials.gov trial status changes (RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED) and FDA Orange Book patent/exclusivity data against verified live public APIs. Fingerprint-based diffing delivers only new or changed records per run, with full-jitter retry and strict ISO 8601 timestamps.
